{{Quote|You've fought against it, you know its weaknesses, and more importantly, you know what a killer it can be. Men, meet the newest addition to the Stormtrooper Corps.|[[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Stormtrooper commander]] [[TK-342]] prior to the [[Battle of Ghorman]]|<ref name="NEGD" />}}
The '''DSD1 Dwarf Spider Droid''', also known as a '''Burrowing Spider Droid''', was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] manufactured by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:DwarfSpiderDroid-CHRON.png|thumb|left|200px|A front view of a dwarf spider droid]]
The droid featured a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] mounted on its dome that was capable of firing either rapid anti-personnel rounds or slower high-intensity blasts that could destroy light vehicles. The [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] small frame and four all-terrain [[Limb/Legends|legs]] made it suitable for warfare in extreme environments or environments with lots of verticality such as [[Mine/Legends|mines]]. Its legs allowed the droid to navigate vertically on walls and narrow cliffsides, while their adjustability allowed it to attain better elevation for its central [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]]. However, because of the fixed [[Laser/Legends|laser]] cannon, it could not turn around to track enemies, thus making it susceptible to speedy targets. The spider droids had very fast reflexes, immediately firing against the Republic gunships flying towards the [[B'omarr Monastery]] on [[Teth]]. They were also very accurate, able to shoot at the gunships that were far away from them and flying fast. They also shot the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] and the [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone gunner]] of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] and hit the feet of the walkers, causing them to fall down the cliff during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]].<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

The droids during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], using their laser cannons to hit the feet of the AT-TE walkers, causing the walkers to fall down the cliff. During the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]], a large number of these droids were utilized to protect the Separatist headquarters during the battle, ambushing potential Republic infiltrators.

Infrared photoreceptors and powerful scanners enabled the Dwarf Spider Droid to survey the terrain and relay target data back to the Homing spider droid. When these scanners identified a target, they sent a tracking message through a digital channel from the head-mounted aerial to the [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|homing spider droid]], which then moved toward the signal to deliver the killing blow. Dwarf Spider Droids also featured a self-destruct mechanism. If a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] unit moved in to destroy the Dwarf Spider Droid, it would usually self-destruct, destroying both itself and any enemies around it. The droid communicated in a beeping language similar to [[Binary/Legends|binary]].

==History==
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Commerce Guild adopted the dwarf spider droid as their equivalent to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Commerce Guild president [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] used the first batch of dwarf spider droids to track down negligent guild members to remind them where their loyalties lay. Some fugitives retreated to mines and tried to erect barricades in the deepest tunnels. Dwarf spider droids annihilated the makeshift barriers of dirt and rock with high-powered laser blasts. This action inspired the nickname "burrowing spider droids".<ref name="NEGD" /> The Guild sent spider droids to wayward members and business rivals as a reminder of their power. Whenever a dispute arose, dwarf spider droids were sent to deal with the situation.<ref>[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 101|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 101]]</ref> They were also sent into mines that weren't willing to pay their monthly dues.<ref name="NEGD" />  

During the Clone Wars, dwarf spider droids were used on the front lines, in front of [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of battle droids and other Separatist droids. The dwarf spider droid also worked in conjunction with the larger [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]] and could operate as an armored scout exploring the battlefields.

[[File:Dwarf_Spider_Dwarf.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A Dwarf Spider Droid during the First Battle of Geonosis]]
Several variants of the dwarf spider droid were used during the wars, including an amphibious model, designed for water-filled terrain such as marshes, swamps, or wetlands. This variant was equipped with a larger gun, but could not float. Two heavily armored variants&mdash;the [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|heavy dwarf spider droid]] and the [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid|advanced dwarf spider droid]] were also utilized. Delta Squad encountered many advanced dwarf spider droids on their missions including two during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], and several during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], where they were used to counter the Republic's [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]] units.

Spider droids fought in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], being among the forces that surrounded [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when he delayed [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] from continuing the battle by discussing terms of surrender to provide time for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] used by the Separatist forces. General Kenobi captured General Loathsom, who told the droids there, including the spider droids, not to shoot at the Jedi Master. Shortly afterwards, the droids would be taken prisoner by clone troopers as the Republic won the battle soon after the destruction of the shield generator.<ref name="TCW film" />

The droids were deployed to Teth to guard the B'omarr Monastery where [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] was being held prisoner. They fired at [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAATs]] and fought against Republic forces scaling the cliff of the mountain atop which the monastery was located, destroying one AT-TE and killing the clone gunner operating the cannon of a second one. They were destroyed by Anakin Skywalker and, later on, when Separatist reinforcements arrived, other spider droids were deployed to the planet, killing the clone pilot driving the remaining AT-TE and hitting one of the legs of the walker, taking it out. Two more spider droids shot at the platform on which Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] had gone to in order to get Rotta away from the building, hitting the nests of [[Can-cell/Legends|Can-cells]]. They destroyed the platform, but debris from it crushed them. Another spider droid was destroyed by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. The Republic won the battle.<ref name="TCW film" />

At least one spider droid was deployed to [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]].<ref name="Defenders of Peace">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref> Spider droids also participated in the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]], during which, being far outnumbered by Separatist forces, the Republic forces had to retreat.<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref> Two were present on [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate]] and fought against clone troopers in the hangar of the ship, but were destroyed during the battle.<ref name="Cargo of Doom">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

They were also deployed during the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] and most were deactivated by the [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]] used by the Republic during the fight. At least one spider droid hadn't been deactivated by the bomb and was attacked by a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]].<ref name="The Zillo Beast">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref> DSD1s also guarded the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] along with other droids.<ref name="Citadel Rescue">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> They fought during the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]] and some attacked Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="Padawan Lost">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref> They also participated in the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]]<ref name="Front Runners">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref> and the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]].<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

Though most Separatist war vehicles were deactivated after the end of the Clone Wars, the dwarf spider droids were recommissioned through Imperial command and used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to enforce the submission of former Separatist worlds to fight against the remnants of the government that had once used them. The [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] used the droids as their mechanical attack dogs, noting their potency in the preceding war.<ref name="NEGD" /> The droids were utilized throughout the Empire's reign, sometimes alongside [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] at Imperial checkpoints. The first deployment of dwarf spider droids in battle on the side of the Empire was against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] forces during the [[Battle of Ghorman|Pacification of Ghorman]].<ref name="NEGD" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The dwarf spider droid first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Early in production, the plan was for the various commerce guilds to employ the same type of battle droids used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], only with different color schemes to differentiate allegiance. It was instead decided to provide a greater visual diversity by designing wholly unique droids for the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], and [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|droid|dwarfspiderdroid|dwarf spider droid}}</ref>
